description.value: Energy-shunting skeleton. Resistance 5 to forced-movement, fall, and crashed-vehicle damage. 1/day, store physical damage taken and release it as bonus damage on your next unarmed Strike (same type, capped 30).

cinderfall.incomplete: The Resistance clause targets forced-movement/fall/crashed-vehicle damage specifically, which has no matching Resistance type: pf2e's damage types don't distinguish fall or forced-movement damage from ordinary bludgeoning, and no roll option marks a damage instance as coming from one of those sources for a predicate to test against -- granting a plain bludgeoning resistance would overstate the card (it would also reduce ordinary weapon damage). The store-and-release mechanic is a separate limited-use (1/day) activated ability needing a granted Action item.
